## Rulings

- **OQ-002** — Are slug collisions acceptable, and if not, what is the target behavior?
  - RULED 2026-08-08 by Dana Ruiz: collisions are NOT acceptable. Slugs must be unique; on collision append a numeric suffix (-2, -3, ...). Existing stored slugs stay exactly as they are — no migration of old data. (PB-003 → REPAIR in WO-002; divergence ED-002)
